rec.name: Cart Drawer Free Shipping Progress Bar with Auto-Added Free Gift
rec.status: Built — launched to live theme (customer enables it via theme settings)

what.text: A cart drawer module with a free-shipping progress bar. A message above the bar gives delivery reassurance ("Great choice! Your order will arrive in 2-3 working days"). Below the bar, a line states how much is still missing for free shipping ("Only €15.40 left for free shipping"). The bar has end-point icons, including a configurable gift icon. A free gift can be unlocked at a minimum cart value and is added to the cart automatically as a €0 line item once the threshold is reached.

why.text: The progress bar uses the goal-gradient effect: the closer shoppers get to a reward, the more motivated they are to finish. The "only X left" wording makes the gap feel small and concrete, which encourages add-ons that raise AOV. A free gift adds a tangible, loss-averse incentive, because shoppers don't want to lose the gift by dropping below the threshold. The delivery-time message lowers purchase anxiety.

how.text: Build it as a cart drawer (mini-cart) section with theme settings. 1) Enable the free-item feature with a toggle. 2) Set a headline for the gift and a minimum cart amount that unlocks it. 3) Pick the gift product(s) with the product picker and turn on 'Auto add'. 4) Paste custom SVG markup for the gift icon on the progress bar. 5) The bar and 'amount missing' text update from the cart total against the free-shipping threshold. The gift product must exist in the shop with a price of €0. If the product is also sold as a normal purchasable item, create a separate free product or variant. Once the condition is met, the rule adds the gift automatically. Customers cannot decline it, and it can only be removed in the editor by removing the product from the gift list. Known caveat: if the gift sells out, it can no longer be added, but the section still shows it as a free gift, so the merchant must disable the free-gift function manually. The original theme had a 'hidden' product tag feature that hid every quantity selector and showed an extra 'remove bundle' button. It conflicted with the gift and was commented out in the live theme.

items: Free gift minimum amount (e.g. 3000, likely in cents = €30)
Gift products (product picker with change/remove all)
Progress bar gift icon (custom SVG code)
Free-shipping threshold and message texts (assumed to be configurable)
Feature switch in theme settings, since the customer enables it there

dependencies.text: A free gift product with price €0 (separate product or variant if the item is also sold at full price). Inventory must be managed manually: a sold-out gift cannot be added but is still displayed. Requires the custom cart drawer (mini-cart.liquid) with the code added in the Sectionfy theme. The theme's legacy 'hidden' tag quantity-selector logic had to be removed to avoid conflicts. No external app is mentioned.
